info.name: PPMI Workflow API
info.description:
PPMI Workflow API Collection
Base URL: https://v2.ppmi.wildanworks.space
QS flow: see docs/flow-quotation.md. Insurance approval returns INSURANCE_APPROVED; Policy issuance is a separate module.

item.name: Export Approved QS (data for the document)

formdata.description: Free text, e.g. PHOTO, SURAT_LAUT. Default OTHER.

request.description: Sets endDate. The record stays in the history.
Scheduler only. Sends Authorization: Bearer <CRON_SECRET>. Safe to run repeatedly: reminders are never duplicated.
Exactly one LEADER. Shares must total exactly 100.00.
Quotation must be INSURANCE_APPROVED. The file is optional.
documentType: POLICY_DOCUMENT, SIGNED_QS, CN_DN, RENEWAL_ATTACHMENT, OTHER
Prefilled form for a READY_FOR_INVOICE RFI. Nothing is saved.
